verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only a small fixed set of first-party integrations: calendar, inbox and Slack, plus a Todoist import. Nothing shows a browsable directory or marketplace of third-party apps and connectors that a user can pick from and add. Fixed built-in integrations are adjacent to this story, not the directory capability it names.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can browse a directory of third-party apps and connectors and add them to the assistant
